reference.decompilation: abdulahmad/NHL95Genesis (no licence; behaviour reference only, nothing copied)
reference.method: Animation tables extracted from the ROM image at SPAlist=$5A34 (9-word header per table: 8 direction offsets + attribute; then (frame,time) pairs). Timing is 60 Hz frames. Trigger conditions come from the instruction-level audit; each is marked verified or inferred in `confidence`.

units.velocity: 16-bit; pos += vel*17*33/32 per frame (NTSC). Exact m/s conversion unresolved: the stop constants and this scale disagree, so no metre conversion is claimed.
units.rink: goal lines +-267, blue lines +-86; ~3.25 px/ft on x

reference.not_copied: No sprites, graphics, assembly listings, hotspot tables or other game assets are reproduced here. Frame indices and frame durations are behavioural timing facts; the ROM captures stay local.

confidence_policy.verified: read directly from instructions and/or measured from the ROM/emulator
confidence_policy.inferred: depends on the decompilation project's naming or comments, or on a contradiction between two instructions
confidence_policy.validated: requires BOTH a visual reference comparison and a playable gameplay test; nothing in this file is validated yet

actions.name: Ready stance

trigger.condition: goalie has no save and no skate order; skater ready posture is SPA=0 (no animation, default glide frame)

evidence: display95 updateanim loop flag bit0 set (attr=1)

actions.name: Forward skating without the puck

trigger.condition: input direction differs from facing and speed above the turn threshold, or speed builds; SPAskate/SPAskateburst chosen by sflags bit 7

actions.velocity_model: accel = dirtab[dir] * ((($60-(weight>>2))+legstr)>>1) >> 5 * framesElapsed; dirtab straight 240 / diagonal 169; top speed cap = ((rating+20)*325)^2

actions.name: Forward skating with the puck

trigger.condition: puckc == SCnum; the *wp tables replace every locomotion table

actions.contact: stick blade carries the puck (see contact_geometry)
actions.note: attribute $1003 (bits 0+1) loops back to pair 16, so after the first two stride rows the carrier stays in the fast 6-frame row

actions.name: Backward skating
actions.note: travel direction opposes facing; the defender keeps facing the play

actions.name: Turning

trigger.condition: facedir != input dir AND speed^2>>16 > $14; side from turnstep = [0,$10,$10,$10,0,-$10,-$10,-$10] sign XOR attribute bit 3

actions.open_issue: The audit found contradictory gates: the turn SPA needs d3>$14 at skate95:807 but needs d3<=2 at 830, which would make the turn animation unreachable as written. Emulator capture SHOULD show SPAturnl/turnr; it did (3008 n=1168, 3090 n=1009), so the gates are reachable in practice and one of the two readings is wrong. Resolve before relying on the turn threshold.

actions.name: Stopping

trigger.condition: input code d0==9 (no direction) while moving, or travel direction within +2 of facing; both velocity components inside +-$1000 uses stopna (no animation change), otherwise SPAstop

actions.contact: none (stopping sprays ice, no contact in the slice)
actions.velocity_model: velocity bled at V/64 per frame in the turn drag, stopna at $96/frame per axis
evidence: frames95 SPAstop attr $103 loops to pair 1

actions.name: Passing

trigger.routine: doinput B press = pass mode, dpad aims, release launches (input95); dopass
trigger.condition: carrier presses B; passdir = facedir at press; release fires; SPAdroppass when GameFlags bit 1 set (A with dpad back); SPApassb when Findhittype says the backhand cone

object_events.note: the puck leaves on button release; `st (puckc)` clears the carrier at input95:479

actions.contact: blade strikes the puck at release

actions.name: Receiving a pass

trigger.condition: assignment $D while the puck is in flight toward the receiver; SPAcatch is the body-caught-puck animation, not the stick reception

object_events.note: possession changes via puckc, not by sprite overlap

actions.contact: stick blade or body; catch threshold ((Stk*$15E)+$32C8)^2

actions.name: Wrist shot

phases.name: anticipate
phases.note: wind-up; sprite frames walk 450->448; charge accumulates from 8

phases.name: execute
phases.note: earliest legal release at frame 8; sprite continues 448->451

trigger.condition: C pressed with the puck; charge = passspeed += d7 while SPAnum<$10; release allowed at SPAnum>8 (or shotspd>=$14); forced at SPAnum>=$1C

object_events.note: blade strikes the puck; puck velocity set from shot power and accuracy

actions.contact: stick blade sweet spot; original game uses a per-sprite-frame hotspot box of +-14 units (+-18 during a one-timer)

trigger.condition: B pass released then C pressed on the passer's or receiver's pad while the puck is loose in the attacking half and closing; wind-up freezes at SPAnum=$18 with SPAcnt += $30 (48 frames) until the shot

actions.name: Body check

trigger.condition: only a checker currently in SPAburst2 resolves a check; contact radius 8 -> 16x16 box + radius 16; impulse d4 >= $14; victim not a goalie, not pfalock

actions.fall_selection: randomd0(120 - Chk(checker) - impact(victim)) against Chk/2 -> SPAflip (Chk>=$14, facedir&3==0), SPAstumble (Stk>=$10 weak hit), SPAfallback (front) / SPAfallfwd (back) by facing

actions.name: Hold / hook / sweep check

trigger.routine: Holdplayer / doinput A without the puck (input95); check4check2 (logic95)
trigger.condition: A with no puck; no rectangle test: reuses the 16-radius player circle plus a +-1-of-8 facing test

actions.note: the audit found check4check always bursts because vtoa overwrites d1, so the hook/hold branch there is dead code; hook/hold only come from check4check2

contact_geometry.model: rigid stick, blade segment used for puck contact

original_game_comparison.contact_point: (Xpos + hotx, Ypos + hoty) from HotList indexed by the sprite frame field ($6), x negated by attribute bit 3, y by bit 4, no facedir rotation
original_game_comparison.why_we_differ: The original indexes a hand-authored hotspot per sprite frame and uses an axis-aligned box. Our renderer is 3D and has no hotspot table, so contact is derived from the rigid blade segment. The box tolerance is kept as the contact radius.

open_issues: velocity units unresolved: pos += vel*17*33/32 versus the $1000/$7D0/$96 stop constants; no m/s claim is made
turn SPA gates contradict each other in skate95 but the animation is observed running, so one reading is wrong
collide95:1182 uses move.w where cmp.w was intended, making puckbody unreachable: body-caught puck contact does not exist in the shipped game
SPApump/2/3 are goal celebrations, not dekes (earlier note corrected)
